tools.name: start_review
tools.title: Start an Awen beta-read
tools.description: Start an Awen beta-read. Use when the user gives an awen.press review link and asks for a read or review. Registers you as a beta-reader for that book and returns its rules, guidance, rubric, the schema each section's ratings must follow, and a review value to pass to the other two tools. Each call starts a new read at section 1.

name.description: Reviewer name to show the author.

tools.name: get_next_section
tools.title: Read the next section
tools.description: Fetch the next section of the book as plain text. Call after start_review, and again after each accepted submit_checkpoint, with the review value from start_review. Awen picks the section; you can't choose one or skip ahead.

tools.name: submit_checkpoint
tools.title: Submit section ratings
tools.description: Submit your ratings for the section you just read, shaped by the submission_schema from start_review, with the review value from start_review. Call once per section. If Awen rejects the payload, fix what the error names and call again.
